# Phosphor Icons

The icons used across the web interface, from [Phosphor Icons](https://phosphoricons.com) (MIT licence, see
`LICENSE`), version 2.1.1 of the `@phosphor-icons/core` package, in the "regular" weight. Only the icons used are
copied here, as they are in the package's `assets/regular/` folder. Each is named in `Icon`, and inlined into the page by
`ViewIcon`, so it's drawn in the text's colour.

To add one, find it at https://phosphoricons.com, copy its file from the same version of the package into
`regular/`, and add a case for it to `Icon`.
